label: Chopping wood
prop: a woodcutting axe gripped securely in both hands
poses: raise axe over outside shoulder; swing axe down toward a tree trunk outside the frame; low follow-through at waist height; draw axe back ready for the next swing

label: Picking berries
prop: a small berry basket hanging from the left forearm
poses: bend forward and reach right hand out; pinch berries with right fingertips; draw right hand back toward basket; drop berries into basket and begin reaching again

label: Tending fields
prop: a wooden hoe held firmly in both hands
poses: extend hoe forward low; press blade into soil ahead; pull hoe blade back toward boots with bent elbows; lift blade and extend again

label: Quarrying stone
prop: a steel pickaxe held in both hands
poses: raise pickaxe diagonally above shoulder; drive pickaxe downward ahead of boots; crouched low impact follow-through; pull pickaxe free and begin lifting

label: Mining gold
prop: a narrow prospecting pick gripped in the right hand with a small ore pouch on the belt
poses: draw pick back above shoulder; lean forward and drive pick into a waist-high vein outside frame; hold low strike follow-through with left hand bracing; withdraw pick and reset

label: Building
prop: a carpenters mallet in right hand and a wooden peg held low in left hand
poses: position the peg in front at waist level; raise mallet with bent elbow; strike downward while left hand clears the strike; lift mallet to reset

label: Repairing
prop: a small hammer in right hand and a short replacement board held by left hand
poses: lean forward to position board; draw hammer back close to shoulder; give precise short hammer tap; inspect board and reset hand

label: Dismantling · study pose
prop: a long iron pry bar held in both hands
poses: plant bar ahead at waist level; brace boots and lean body back pulling bar; rock forward to release; reposition bar ahead

label: Carrying timber
prop: three short rough-cut logs cradled horizontally across both forearms against the abdomen
poses: left boot forward on ground right boot behind; right boot lifted passing the planted left boot with LOW knee; right boot forward on ground left boot behind; left boot lifted passing planted right boot with LOW knee

label: Carrying food
prop: a wicker basket full of red apples and greens carried in both hands against the abdomen
poses: left boot forward on ground right boot behind; right boot lifted passing planted left boot with LOW knee; right boot forward on ground left boot behind; left boot lifted passing planted right boot with LOW knee

label: Carrying stone
prop: a squat wooden hod containing three heavy gray stones supported by both hands against the abdomen
poses: left boot forward with a heavy planted step; right boot passing left close to ground; right boot forward with heavy planted step; left boot passing right close to ground

label: Carrying gold
prop: a reinforced leather ore sack in both hands, open top showing gold-flecked gray ore
poses: left boot forward right boot behind; right boot passing planted left with low knee; right boot forward left boot behind; left boot passing planted right with low knee

label: Carrying supplies · study pose
prop: a small wooden supply crate with rope handles gripped securely in both hands
poses: left boot forward right boot behind; right boot passing planted left with low knee; right boot forward left boot behind; left boot passing planted right with low knee

label: Defensive strike
prop: a stout wooden tool handle gripped in both hands as a defensive staff
poses: guard stance then coil shoulders and pull staff behind shoulder; decisive forward diagonal strike at an opponent chest height; strong extended follow-through with weight on front foot; retract staff into a balanced guarded stance

label: Hit reaction
prop: empty hands, all tools stowed on belt
poses: balanced standing; sharp recoil shoulders back with bent knees; twist away shielding ribs with one forearm; recover upright with hands lowered

label: Shield · block impact
prop: empty hands, tools stowed, NO physical shield
poses: brace in a staggered stance with forearms raised before face; recoil a little behind raised forearms; press open palms forward resolutely; settle into protective ready stance

label: Stunned · study pose
prop: empty hands, tools stowed
poses: head bowed slightly one hand at temple; weight sinks onto bent left knee; slow dazed tilt toward right with same feet planted; steady herself returning toward first pose

label: Fall · study pose
prop: empty hands, tools remain strapped to belt
poses: knees give way and shoulders sag; sink onto one knee using left hand on ground; roll gently onto hip and forearm; lie still on side with bent knees. Non-graphic, no blood. Keep same body scale throughout including lying pose, leaving ample horizontal room

label: Shield · awakening
prop: empty hands, no physical shield, NO painted glow or effects
poses: near collapse on one knee with one hand over heart; lift head and open palm; rise to both feet with both palms opening outward; stand firmly protected with palms gently lowered

label: Last Light · release
prop: empty hands, no physical shield, NO painted magic effects
poses: draw hands close to chest and look toward aggressor; spread elbows as shoulders lift with resolve; extend open palms toward aggressor releasing the curse; lower palms and settle calmly

label: Last Light · curse reaction
prop: empty hands, tools stowed, NO painted rune or magical effects
poses: upright looking ahead; flinch and glance upward toward an unseen mark above head; clutch chest and draw breath with knees slightly bent; stand weakened but alert. This is an inspection pose, no death
